name: Traveler's Noticeboard
description: A warded bulletin board outside an inn in Precinct Five of Ravnica that only planeswalkers can see, used for trades and messages.

timeline.summary: Huatli sees a note on the Traveler's Noticeboard seeking raw copper and starts a correspondence with its author, R.
timeline.quote: Not one to leave a stranger in want, Huatli rises on her tiptoes to snag an old piece of paper
